body.statement: For \(\mathcal D\), the largest bidirected district has size \(b=2\), the two distinct deterministic directed paths \(r\to a\to c\to y\) and \(r\to b\to c\to y\) induce the same single transition arc \(u_\beta\to t\), and the unique minimal failure support is \(\{e_1,e_2\}\). Hence the projected enumerator emits \(\{e_1,e_2\}\) once, independently of the number of deterministic paths represented by that transition arc.
body.justification: The instance exposes the exact duplicate mechanism that deterministic-path projection must quotient before enumeration.
body.gap: Ordinary path enumeration visits both arms of the deterministic diamond even though neither arm changes the uncertain-edge support.
body.consumer: It is a worked regression test for projection, label-union canonicalization, and duplicate suppression in the width-two compiler.
